answer: Agents could earn participation weight only after locking a scarce deposit that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated fake identities. Auditors sample actions, compare shared funding and synchronized behavior, and publish evidence before penalties; a walnut-sized deposit is still costly when an attacker must repeat it across identities. A plume of linked accounts may look diverse, but shared control risks forfeiting every bond, while quartz-like pseudonyms alone earn no weight. The attacker must tie up real capital and risk losing it to gain influence.
